architecture: Visual 3D scene-graph editor powered by React Three Fiber, Rapier rigid-body physics, and WebGL fragment post-processing shaders.
codingStyle: Declarative R3F components, strict state synchronization using Zustand, physics scaling boundaries, and custom mesh shaders.
preferredPatterns: WebSocket native bridge push transmissions on port 5556
knownProblems: 32-bit single-precision float coordinate origin jitter when scaling scenes over 500m.
Frame rate stuttering under heavy post-processing ambient occlusion filters.
